description: This bar chart illustrates the number of tasks associated with different language families. The horizontal axis is labeled “# tasks” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. The vertical axis displays language family categories, listed as IE-Slavic, IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, Uralic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, Turkic, and Basque, listed in descending order based on bar length. Each language family is represented by a single bar of a distinct color: IE-Slavic is light blue, IE-Romance is dark blue, IE-Germanic is light green, Uralic is green, IE-Baltic is light red, IE-other is red, IE-Indic is orange, Semitic is dark orange, Turkic is purple, and Basque is dark purple. The bar for IE-Slavic extends to approximately 77 tasks, while the shortest bar represents Turkic with approximately 2 tasks. The bar heights are consistently different, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlines, or annotations.
